_comment: Hand-authored corrections to lexicon_bands.csv + kaikki joins. Applied by build_lexicon.
exclude: the lemma is not teachable vocabulary — subtitle artefacts (English names, English
leakage, diacritic-less typos, inflected forms that escaped lemmatisation). They stay in the
lexicon (their subtitle_count still feeds the coverage meter) but are hidden from lessons/SRS.
pos / gloss_en fixes: cases where kaikki's entry pick was wrong (a surname entry for `možný`).
Every exclusion was checked against the §15.2 bug-#1 rule: is this actually a Slovak word?
`co`/`ze`/`ked`/`ano` are Czech-or-typo variants of čo/že/keď/áno; `jo` is Czech `yes`
(heard in SK speech — kept, tagged colloquial, not excluded); `kámo`, `sranda`, `decko`,

exclude.amerika: proper noun — Amerika; teach in the countries lesson, not SRS
exclude.oci: typo for oči (eyes) — the real lemma is oko

vytvoriť.why: kaikki says 'imperfective' — it is the perfective

stan.why: drop the vulgar secondary sense from the gloss

vianoce.why: plural-only noun, not a proper name for SRS purposes

a.why: already fixed by POS_PRIORITY; recorded for completeness
